Do you have a question to ask?
At an Ordinary Meeting of Council, the public may ask questions of Council without notice at agenda item ‘Questions from the Galley’.
Public question time will be limited to thirty (30) minutes per Ordinary Council Meeting. The Mayor will determine the order in which members of the public will speak and all questions are to be asked through the Presiding Member. For further information on this process, please refer to the Public Question Time Policy.
Alternatively, members of the public are always welcome to email their questions directly to Elected Members or Council at walkerville@walkerville.sa.gov.au

Do you have a question to ask?
At an Ordinary Meeting of Council, the public may ask questions of Council without notice at agenda item ‘Questions from the Galley’.
Public question time will be limited to thirty (30) minutes per Ordinary Council Meeting. The Mayor will determine the order in which members of the public will speak and all questions are to be asked through the Presiding Member. For further information on this process, please refer to the Public Question Time Policy.
Alternatively, members of the public are always welcome to email their questions directly to Elected Members or Council at walkerville@walkerville.sa.gov.au

Do you have a question to ask?
At an Ordinary Meeting of Council, the public may ask questions of Council without notice at agenda item ‘Questions from the Galley’.
Public question time will be limited to thirty (30) minutes per Ordinary Council Meeting. The Mayor will determine the order in which members of the public will speak and all questions are to be asked through the Presiding Member. For further information on this process, please refer to the Public Question Time Policy.
Alternatively, members of the public are always welcome to email their questions directly to Elected Members or Council at walkerville@walkerville.sa.gov.au
